name: Francoli Gourmet
tagline: Authentic handmade Piedmontese pastas, regional Italian wines, and espresso bar
description: An authentic taste of Northern Italy on South Glassell. Chef-owner Claudio Francoli curates an exquisite menu of handmade pastas (agnolotti, pappardelle al cinghiale), artisanal risotto, imported prosciutto di Parma, and an intimate wine bar.
historicNote: Situated in a handsome 1911 two-story brick building, featuring an authentic Italian salumeria and wine cellar downstairs.

specials.title: Pasta Fresca Tuesday
specials.description: Enjoy any signature fresh handmade pasta + glass of house Chianti for $25.

specials.title: Sommelier Piedmontese Tasting
specials.description: Half-priced bottles of Barolo and Barbera d’Alba with any two meat or seafood entrees.

specials.title: Gourmet Panini & Salad Lunch
specials.description: Prosciutto di Parma on warm focaccia + Tuscan arugula salad for $16.50.

specials.title: Sunday Truffle Risotto Feature
specials.description: Chef’s seasonal black truffle carnaroli risotto with Parmigiano-Reggiano aged 24 months.

researchMetadata.verificationNotes: Northern Italian handmade pastas, regional wine pairings, and Piedmontese cuisine verified.
